column1: Taxonomic information of Potter Cove benthic species
Information was retrieved from WoRMS (WoRMS Editorial Board 2025).
The taxonomic tree and correlation matrix were constructed using data.tree and ape R-packages (Paradis & Schliep 2019, Glur 2024).
Glur, C. (2024). data.tree: General Purpose Hierarchical Data Structure. R package version 1.1.0. https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=data.tree
Paradis, E., & Schliep, K. (2019). ape 5.0: an environment for modern phylogenetics and evolutionary analyses in R. Bioinformatics, 35(3), 526–528. https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/bty633
